pages.title: Interest policy
body: Monthly interest = category balance x annual rate / 1200.
Interest is TRUNCATED to the cent, never rounded. This was confirmed in the 2019 audit and matches our card network agreement.
Changes to this rule need sign-off from the Card Services manager.

pages.title: Fees policy
body: Late and over-limit fees are assessed by the Billing platform, not by the mainframe interest job.
The mainframe only reports balances; Billing reads TRANSACT the next morning.

pages.title: Disclosure group runbook
body: Every account group falls back to the DEFAULT disclosure group when its own rate row is missing.
The DEFAULT row must always exist. The DISCGRP load job checks for it before INTCALC runs.
If DEFAULT is missing, INTCALC abends. That is intended: never charge interest at an unknown rate.

pages.title: Account data dictionary
body: ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE (sic) is stored as text YYYY-MM-DD.
Because of that format, comparing dates as strings orders them correctly; no conversion needed.

pages.title: PCI controls for batch
body: No card numbers or balances may appear in job output (SYSOUT).

pages.title: Nightly batch schedule
body: Order: POSTTRAN, then INTCALC, then TRANREPT.
INTCALC must run after posting so interest sees the day's transactions.
